description: One change to up to 100 mentions at once (ids from search_mentions): status ("ignored", "done", "open"), assigneeId (a member, null to unassign), addLabels and removeLabels (removals first, so moving a label is one call). All of it lands or none of it does; ids the workspace has no mention by come back in notFound, and a mention still being classified keeps its status (it is listed in pending) but takes the labels and assignee. Use it to triage a page of results, or to label mentions that existed before an automation.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional. A unique value (a UUID) for this call: 1 to 255 visible ASCII characters, no spaces. Calling again with the same key and the same input within 24 hours returns the first result instead of doing it twice.

ids.description: Mention ids (mm_...), 1 to 100: a page of GET /v1/mentions.

update.description: Every field is optional, at least one is required; omitted fields are untouched.

addLabels.description: Labels to add; a mention keeps at most 20, and labels past that are not added.

assigneeId.description: A workspace member (user id), or null to unassign.

removeLabels.description: Labels to remove; a label a mention does not carry is ignored.

status.description: ignored or done to handle them; open to put them back.

name: update_mentions
title: Update mentions
